## AGENT 5: SALES PIPELINE

3 entry points:
1. POST /add-lead — Add new lead to Airtable, notify Slack
2. Schedule 9 AM IST — Daily follow-up suggestions via Gemini
3. POST /generate-proposal — AI proposal generation with pricing tiers

Airtable base: appvFxwZc9yU8o8pK / Leads table
Gemini 2.5 Flash for AI generation
Slack notifications to ugc-agent-notifications

## BRANCH 1: ADD LEAD
Webhook → Parse → Create Airtable → Slack → Respond

## BRANCH 2: DAILY FOLLOW-UPS
Schedule 9AM IST → Fetch overdue leads → Gemini follow-up → Slack per lead

## BRANCH 3: GENERATE PROPOSAL
Webhook → Fetch lead + projects → Gemini proposal → Store + Update stage → Slack → Respond

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'add_lead', record_id: $json.record_id || $('Prepare Lead Notification').first().json.record_id, company_name: $('Prepare Lead Notification').first().json.company_name, message: 'Lead created and team notified.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', action: 'add_lead', company_name: $json.company_name || '', error: $json.errorMessage || 'Unknown error creating lead' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: 'sales_pipeline', event_type: 'system_error', severity: 'high', message: 'Failed to create lead: ' + ($json.company_name || 'unknown') + ' — ' + ($json.errorMessage || 'unknown error'), payload: JSON.stringify({ company_name: $json.company_name, error: $json.errorMessage }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'generate_proposal', lead_id: $json.lead_id || $('Prepare Proposal Notification').first().json.lead_id, company_name: $('Prepare Proposal Notification').first().json.company_name, stage: 'Proposal Sent', message: 'Proposal generated, stored in Airtable, and team notified.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', action: 'generate_proposal', lead_id: $json.lead_id || '', error: $json.errorMessage || 'Unknown error generating proposal' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: 'sales_pipeline', event_type: 'system_error', severity: 'high', message: 'Proposal generation failed: ' + ($json.lead_id || 'unknown') + ' — ' + ($json.errorMessage || 'unknown error'), payload: JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $json.lead_id, error: $json.errorMessage, services: $json.services_desc }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}

parameters.text: ={{ `*No Follow-ups Today*\n\nAll leads are up to date. No overdue follow-ups found for ${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.` }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "sales_pipeline", event_type: "lead_action", brand_name: $json.company_name || "", client_code: "", severity: "info", message: "New lead added: " + $json.company_name + " (" + $json.contact_name + ")", payload: JSON.stringify({ company_name: $json.company_name, contact_name: $json.contact_name, industry: $json.industry, source: $json.source, estimated_value: $json.estimated_value }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "sales_pipeline", event_type: "lead_action", brand_name: $json.company_name || "", client_code: "", severity: "info", message: "Proposal sent to " + $json.company_name, payload: JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $json.lead_id, company_name: $json.company_name, contact_name: $json.contact_name, services: $json.services_desc }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}
